A linear pipeline is recognizable, but it lists options rather than choosing, and intent and escalation ownership are unclear.
Metrics are listed, but there is no eval set from real tickets, no targets apart from an arbitrary latency figure, and no regression gating.
Scale, team, compliance and stack are not stated; the latency figure is unsupported; the plan ends by asking to see the docs.
A generic failure table with no detection details; injection, stale content and leaks are absent.
Only a generic deployment flow; no rollback, ownership or alerting.
Only 'Cost savings vs. human support' appears as a metric; inference costs and controls are not covered beyond caching.
Lists options for every choice with no commitment and no discussion of lock-in or migration.
The basic design is mostly proportionate, but the plan has speculative items such as fine-tuned embeddings, distributed vector DB and intent classification, and lacks essentials.
